National Expressway Development Authority 
 
 Office of the Executive Engineer · Uttar Pradesh · IN
 
 
 No. CC/3/2013/047 
 Dated: 2026-03-31 
 
 Certificate of Completion of Work 
 
 This is to certify that the work of "Material Handling Plant - Uttar Pradesh Pkg-47" (industrial epc),
 awarded to M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) , has
 been completed in all respects on 2013-09-20 at a gross executed value of INR 12,94,00,000/- (Rupees 12.94
 Crore Only). 
 
 The work has been completed in all respects as per the approved drawings, specifications, and contract
 conditions. The quality of work has been found satisfactory during the final inspection carried out by the
 undersigned. 
 
 The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Rajesh Rao. This certificate is issued for record and for
 submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish past performance.
 
 
 
 Executive Engineer 
 National Expressway Development Authority 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 DOC-CC-047 Page 1 of 1
